config.sample: discovery core P1+P2 (engineering and p0_base_collision excluded)
config.truncation_policy: first 1022 residues, unchanged from the existing screening policy
config.token_policy: <cls> + L residue tokens + <eos>; pooling uses hidden[1:1+L] only; special tokens and padding excluded
config.primary_summary: mean_nterm: mean SAE activation over the first 30 amino-acid positions
config.secondary_summary: mean_visible: mean SAE activation over all visible amino-acid positions
config.eligibility: feature active (>0) at least once within the first 30 positions in at least 5% of discovery proteins; the SAE's training-time dead list is NOT used
config.ranking_statistic: abs(AUROC - 0.5) of the primary summary against the frozen DeepLoc binary label; ties broken by ascending feature id
config.label_source: frozen DeepLoc binary target in deeploc_binary_manifest.tsv

ranking_summary.eligibility_rule: feature active (>0) at least once within the first 30 positions in at least 5% of discovery proteins; the SAE's training-time dead list is NOT used

stability.definition_top20_overlap: |top-20 by |AUROC-0.5| computed on P1 alone  INTERSECT  top-20 computed on P2 alone|, both restricted to the eligible set defined on P1+P2 together
stability.definition_rank_correlation: Spearman rank correlation across all eligible features between the P1 and P2 values of the statistic named; computed on the feature-level statistics, not on proteins
stability.note: Exploratory discovery statistics. No pass quota is applied, the ranking is not altered if agreement is weak, and these are not held-out performance figures. No significance claim is made: the statistic was screened over thousands of features without multiplicity control.
